entries.title: Commission orders Special Intensive Revision of Bihar rolls, qualifying date 1 July 2025
entries.summary: The Commission ordered a Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of the electoral rolls of Bihar, with enumeration forms for every existing elector and a fresh draft roll limited to those who returned a form. The accompanying order said the Commission had decided to begin SIR in the entire country, starting with Bihar because its Assembly election was due. It set a schedule ending in final publication on 30 September 2025.

figures.label: electors on Bihar roll when SIR began

details.issued_by: Letter No.23/2025-ERS (Vol.II) signed by Pawan Diwan, Secretary, ECI, to the CEO Bihar; enclosed Order No.23/ERS/2025 (Annexure A) signed 'By Order' by Sanjay Kumar, Deputy Election Commissioner.
details.legal_basis_claimed: Article 324 of the Constitution; Section 21 of the Representation of the People Act, 1950 'along with other applicable provisions'; Article 326 and Sections 16 and 19 RPA 1950 on eligibility. The order cites Section 21 without naming sub-section (3); the Supreme Court later held the exercise traceable to Section 21(3) read with Article 324.
reasons_recorded: urbanisation and migration causing repeated entries over 20 years
constitutional duty to enrol only citizens (Article 326)
key_rules: Every existing elector as on 24.06.2025 gets a pre-filled Enumeration Form (Annexure C); names of those who do not return it by 25.07.2025 are left out of the draft roll.
The 2003 Bihar roll (qualifying date 01.01.2003) is treated as probative evidence of eligibility, including presumption of citizenship; those on it need only attach the roll extract.
Persons not on the 2003 roll must submit eligibility documents from a prescribed list.
No entry may be deleted from the draft roll without inquiry and a fair opportunity to the person.
Appeals: first to the District Magistrate under Section 24(a) RPA 1950 read with Rule 27 RER 1960; second to the CEO within 30 days under Section 24(b).
New electors and those shifting from outside the state must file Form 6/Form 8 with an additional Declaration Form (Annexure D).
No polling station to exceed 1,200 electors without Commission approval.
Chief Secretary to keep DEO/ERO/AERO posts filled; no transfers without Commission approval during SIR.
details.recorded_objection: None reported at the time. On 23-24 September 2026 the Commission said this order was a unanimous decision of all three Commissioners (see the response entries).
